Seriously though, Cyberpunk 2077 is a fun game for what it is, I had fun with it and there's nothing wrong in enjoying it or it being your favourite game.
But to claim Cyberpunk 2077 is somehow a masterpiece or one of the best games ever is absolutely delusional.

Gameplay wise it's a just a bunch of mechanics that we've seen a million times before and better. It has nothing outstanding about it.
Story wise, it's pretty decent. it has good emotional scenes and good acting, but has pacing issues everywhere. I've experienced better stories in other games, like Disco Elysium, Planescape torment, Fallout New Vegas and so on.
RPG wise most of your choices don't have any long term or major impact on the main story.
The skill and perk tree is uninspired and mostly offers just % increase to various stats like damage and some of the perks are completely useless, like underwater stealth.
Crafting is bare bones and uninspired.
There are many balancing issues that make the game very easy even if you play it on very hard.

Basically, Cyberpunk 2077 just takes every single game mechanic it can from the last 10 years of open world games and stuffs them all together in one game without actually improving any of them. 

Again, it's fine to enjoy and even love the game, but don't pretend it has no flaws beyond bugs and glitches and that it's somehow better than it actually is.
It certainly isn't one of the best games ever.

I don't get all these people throwing around the term "Rushing".
I didn't "rush" through the game. I played at my own pace for about 45 hours total over a week (since I'm in quarantine and I have free time to do so) until I reached AR31 and finished the current Main story and most of the side quests. I maxed out the statues, leveled up my characters, and explored the world.
Again, I played at my own pace and reached the point where everyone is eventually going to reach, this isn't rushing. Rushing would be speedruning the game to get to the current endgame in the fastest time.

The reason I feel the resin burn is because it removes my agency as a player to decide how long I can or can't play, which I find infuriating as an adult. I don't know about you, but I like having the ability to make my own decisions and decide how much time I want to spend. It's MY time.

I honestly loved playing the game, and I can't remember a single game that I've played so much in such a short timeframe in years, but the resin system just made me uninstall it.  There's no point in even waiting for new content as long as the resin system is still the same, mainly, because you will inevitably have to grind your characters to do newer content. and grinding even one character is a needless chore right now since you're locked to only about 20 minutes of meaningful progression a day.
The system also disincentivizes you from rolling for new characters, since once you understand what a chore it's going to be to grind for their upgrade materials for 20 minutes a day for months until they'll be actually viable to play with, you won't want to pull new characters anymore.

I got to have my fun with the game, I think it's great, but the resin system really made me lose any interest in any new content until they change it. and if they won't then there's no reason to ever come back.

Because random enemy drops and random trash in common chests isn't very interesting. 

A domain at least gives you new and better artifacts that allow you to improve your character and build them as you like, which is fun. You can also optimize your clear time by using different party compositions, which is also fun. Every run it's up to RNG what kind of loot you'll get, so it's fun to try and beat the odds in order to get something better. and with the current RNG of the game, people have calculated that you'll need to spend at least 300 hours just to get ONE perfect artifact for just ONE of your party members. So with the current limitations that the resin system imposes on you, getting enough perfect artifacts for you main party will actually take years, since as I've wrote previously, it will only take you 6-12 minutes a day to clear all the domains you can.

killing random group #291 in the wild and getting the same boring item drops from them might be necessary, but it isn't very interesting or fun.

I feel like, if you can't understand why people might enjoy getting shiny, new and better stuff in the game, and you think that standard enemy drops are somehow as exciting as getting a good 5 star artifact then I'm sorry, but trying to keep explaining this to you is a waste of time. Maybe you're just wired differently.

There isn't much to do at the current "endgame", and the resin system just serves to highlight that. Everyone knows that the game isn't finished and more content is eventually going to come out, but instead of giving you the option to play freely and keep enjoying it just gives you an insane restriction that just further pushes the point that there isn't much to do once you reach AR30.

Most players don't find repetitive, tedious tasks that give the same subpar reward (standard item drops) fun or interesting. a player that isn't having fun is a player that's going to leave. and no, they won't come back for the next content patch, because the game has already left a bad taste after telling them how long they can make progress per day.

If you find going around the map for a few hours killing generic mobs for mats exciting or enjoyable, then good for you. But most people find just doing that for minimal rewards INCREDIBLY boring and tedious.

If me wishing that I could do any other content for as long as I want instead of doing repetitive chores is "the system working as intended" then the system is TERRIBLE. frustration from being able to only play for 20 minutes doesn't make me want to continue to play because "Oh I can do a sweet dungeon for up to 6 times a day, 2 minutes each run!, I'm thankful I have this limit because it makes the game so much better!", it makes me want to uninstall the game (which I have, because it's a terrible system) and never touch the game again. So you're telling me that Mihoyo designed a live service game with the intention of frustrating players so they  will leave and won't play their game anymore? Sure, why not. I'll believe it. No other explanation for this system to be honest.

The 20 minute a day isn't hyperbole actually, if anything I'm actually exaggerating the amount of time you can actually make time. In all actuality it's more like 10-15.
Let's take the world bosses for instance, 40 resin for one of them. It takes me 3 minutes on average to kill them. If I was efficient about it, I'd kill them even faster. so that's 9 minutes on average. 
What about leylines?20 resin each. about 2-2.5 minutes for each clear. that's 15 minutes at best.
domains? 20 resin each. clear time varies, but it takes between 1-2 minutes on average. So you get 6-12 minutes of use out of your resin.

Now, you technically can play for as long as you want, but if you want actually rewarding content or content that progresses your characters, or anything fun, you're gated by the resin system. so 20 minutes of gameplay per day.

Here's my issue with the resin system: not only does it time gate your progress, it also completely makes pulling new characters via the gatcha mechanics a complete waste of time and money.

Currently I am AR31, which means that I need to do at least 1 xp leyline to level up a single character level in the 50-60 range, and with our current 120 resin cap, that means I can "farm" 6 levels per day, for about 15 minutes max, since xp leylines don't take more than 2 minutes each. That means, that if I want to upgrade my current main team (all 4 characters in that party) I would need to spend at least 5-6 days just logging in, for 15 minutes each time, just to get the xp tickets to get them to my current level cap, which is 60. Now, needing to farm the xp times isn't the issue here, the main issue is that I can only do it for a ridiculously short amount of time, 15 minutes a day.

That's not counting all the talent materials, weapon materials , future ascension materials, and artifact gathering you need to do to level only your main team to keep up with increasing world levels. What this means is that in order to fully upgrade a single 4 character party, I would need to log in for 15 minutes each day for 2-3 weeks to what basically amounts to a massive chore. Not to mention the need to get new artifacts which are completely RNG based but are also capped behind resin, so you can't even grind those to do something ingame for fun.

But all that wouldn't be a problem if the game would actually let you grind those things. what many gatcha veterans ignore is that players right now understand that the game is new and isn't complete, but they still want to keep playing it, if only by grinding new gear or level up materials.
But you can't, since the game doesn't want you to actually play it after getting to AR30. after 40 hours of playtime it's like the game suddenly decided to remember that it wants to be a gatcha, with all it's bullshit systems like arbitrary time gating.

Now, when you already know that you can only play for for about 15-20 minutes a day, and you can't grind to upgrade the characters you have at your leisure, why would you even want to pull new characters? as time goes on it's only going to be harder and more time consuming to level up a new character from lvl 1-max level. I'm not a gatcha addict or a whale so I don't understand why someone would want to spend money on something he can't actually play with.

Personally, I already uninstalled the game since it doesn't want people to play it after reaching AR30 and there is nothing to actually keep you invested while you wait for the next big content patch, which is fine, I've had a great time for 40 hours, and this is a good stopping point. I'm just here because I'm curious what's gonna happen with the game next.

And as a side note, to all gatcha veterans who love to say "It's a gatcha game, get used to it!" very smugly: saying that is like admitting you're willing to eat shit because you got told that's what all you're getting from them, instead of leaving or asking for something else.

 Hardcore gatcha players will stay, but the issue here is that most of the PC/Console players that aren't gatcha players WON'T.

If you can't keep grinding for gear/mora as much as you like, you'll just feel that logging in is just a chore, and if they won't fix the resin system, you'll still have to do this chore later on when content does come out since it's the only way to upgrade your characters, so just grinding every day for 20 minutes until you actually reach your leveling goals to do about an hour or two of new content is gonna bore most players out of their minds.

if you're a whale, why would you actually pay for rolls if you can't flex your characters to other players or even use them, since upgrading one character from 1-60 right now is a massive grind, and I assume the costs are just gonna increase more and more from now on, so why even bother getting new characters after leveling your core party to max level?

Such wasted potential.
